messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for /v1/stream (region: us-west-2). 5min p99 = 2.4s (SLO 1.5s). Paging oncall.
maya: I’m paged, looking.
maya: quick summary pls — customer visible? which models/routes?
leo: seeing spike on streaming route. Affected models: redwood-13b-quant and redwood-7b-v2. Traffic ~30% higher than baseline but not enough to explain p99.
maya: got graphs? link?
leo: Grafana: https://grafana.internal/goto/streaming_p99_usw2 (sharing panels). p95 ~ 350ms, p99 spikes to 2.2-2.6s. Streaming stalls / tail waits, not token-generation slowdowns.
sarah: logs show a ton of `kv_cache_eviction` WARNs on inference-node-*. Shard 7 eviction rate jumped.
raj: I’m seeing high prefill queue times vs decode times. Prefill latency distribution skewed: many prefill ops stuck 1.5-3s, decode still ~100ms.
maya: so prefill vs decode imbalance -> tail latency for streaming because KV misses/prefills block the first tokens?
leo: yes. Prefill paths require KV rehydrate from disk/remote for fragmented shards. Fragmentation increased after yesterday's scaling event.
emily: customer impact: a few enterprise customers reported timeouts in the last 20m. Support tickets linked: INC-4521, INC-4523. We should mark potential customer impact.
maya: thanks. Assigning oncall tasks: leo + raj investigate root cause and mitigation. sarah look at shard health and evictions. emily coordinate with support for affected customers and incident comms.
leo: digging into metrics: PromQL used:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(prefill_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
prefill ops p99 jumps match the streaming p99. Also see KV cache occupancy per shard:
```
sum(kv_cache_items{shard=~"7|8|9"}) by (shard)
```
shard 7 occupancy low but eviction churn high -> compact fragmentation.
raj: checked node logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:07:12Z WARN kv: eviction: candidate_count=1200 prefill_wait=1803ms
2026-03-15T14:07:13Z WARN kv: decode: miss_rate=0.12 prefill_latency=2200ms
```
maya: immediate mitigation options? increase eviction threshold, disable prefill for streaming, fallback to smaller model, scale up shard replicas?
sarah: quick /safe mitigations we can do without deploy: 1) increase kv cache soft eviction limit to reduce churn 2) temporarily route streaming to different shards 3) enable transient cache-boost (bump mem quota) on affected hosts 4) as last resort, failover streaming to redwood-7b-v1 (lower mem pressure).
leo: I can patch the routing policy to avoid hot shard 7 for new requests. Doing a canary replace now.
leo: `kubectl patch configmap routing --type merge -p '{"data":{"avoid_shards":"7"}}'`
ops-bot: Deploy started for routing-config patch by leo (change-id: rout-3842). Rolling update 12/250 pods.
maya: raj, can you increase eviction threshold on nodes in us-west-2? Config path `/etc/redwood/kv.conf` param `evict_soft_ratio` from 0.75 -> 0.82
raj: doing that now via ssm run: `ssm send-command --document-name "UpdateKvConfig" --targets ... --parameters evict_soft_ratio=0.82`
raj: config applied to 8/10 nodes, restarting kv agent on the others.
emily: support update drafted: "Investigating elevated tail-latency affecting streaming responses in us-west-2. Engineers mitigating; some customers may see increased response times. ETA 30-60m." Thoughts?
maya: fine. Add note about potential timeouts and advise retry/backoff.
leo: routing patch canary looks good — early pods show p99 down to ~1.6s. Rolling to 50%.
sarah: eviction churn reduced where config applied. Prefill p99 trending down to 700-900ms on patched nodes.
raj: patch completed. Restarted kv agent on last 2 nodes, all nodes now show reduced eviction logs.
incident-bot: Incident status changed: acknowledged -> mitigation in progress. Incident severity: Sev2.
maya: good work. Next steps: leave routing avoid for 2 hours, monitor. Plan permanent fix: reduce fragmentation via background compaction and update prefill heuristics to prefer local decode when fragmentation > threshold.
leo: I can put up a PR for heuristic change — prefer decode-first when shard_eviction_rate > X. Will include tests and canary flag.
emily: Customer comms updated with second note: mitigation in progress; some customers see intermittent high latency, retries recommended. Linking to status page.
maya: handoff: I need to go offline in 10m. Leo you’ll take primary oncall for next 2 hours, raj on infra, sarah on kv health. Tag @pagerduty for escalations.
leo: taking over. Will run a 1h watch and follow up with a post-incident writeup.
sarah: started background compaction job on shard 7 at 14:42 UTC: `kv-compact --shard 7 --max-io=50`.
raj: compaction progress 20% after 10m. Expect improved locality.
leo: monitoring p99: now steady ~480-600ms across region. Streaming stalls largely gone.
incident-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: p99 returned within SLO for 10 consecutive minutes. Marking incident resolved->monitoring.
emily: will close support tickets once we confirm no regressions.
maya: thanks team. After action items: 1) PR for prefill heuristic (leo) 2) persistent compaction schedule + ops runbook update (sarah/raj) 3) postmortem with timeline and customer impact (maya/emily).
maya: closing thread, will create postmortem channel.
